Brightwater’s households paid more. The difference in water use was 3,315 − 2,806 = 509 megalitres = 509,000 cubic metres. At 142.35 tenge per cubic metre, the difference was 72,455,? 509,000 × 142.35 = 72,455,? Calculating: 142.35 × 509 = 72,? 142.35 × 500 = 71,175; ×9 = 1,281.15; total 72,456.15 thousand tenge = 72.46 million tenge.

ANSWER: Brightwater | 72.46
